mapper.sql: select category_id, category_name, order_num, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from shop_category
mapper.select: select c.category_id, c.category_name, c.order_num, c.status, c.del_flag, c.create_time, c.remark, (select count(1) from shop_product p where p.category_id = c.category_id and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' and p.is_available = '1') as product_count from shop_category c where c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' order by c.order_num, c.category_id
mapper.insert: insert into shop_category( category_name, order_num, status, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{categoryName}, #{orderNum}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update shop_category set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where category_id = #{categoryId}
